outcome: Metformin levels in maternal and fetal tissues
cohort: 11 pregnant Rhesus dams (after excluding 2) initiated on metformin or vehicle control by gestational day 30
finding: Maternal metformin use during pregnancy in Rhesus monkeys resulted in fetal bioaccumulation of the drug, associated with fetal growth restriction and renal dysmorphology.
mod_finding: This study used cesarean delivery to deliver primate fetuses at G145 to study the effects of metformin.
birth_weight: Significantly lower in the metformin group (p<0.0001)
